2024_general.fact: Seed eastlandcountytexas.com page 404 (https) / 403 (http); site moved to eastlandcounty.gov (CivicPlus). '2024 November 5th General Election' page has one result file, 'Unofficial Cumulative Results Report (PDF)' (DocumentCenter/View/1272): scanned county totals, printed 'Run Time 12:30 PM, Run Date 11/06/2024', 'Polling Places Reporting 9 of 9', CreationDate Nov 6 2024 17:40 UTC. After election night; no election-night file survives. CivicPlus Last-Modified equals request time (no upload evidence). No Clarity link. check 3 unavailable (no Eastland folder on wayback-data).

2026_primary.fact: '2026 March Primary' page lists only notices, sample ballots ('Precinct 1 (PDF)' ... are sample ballots) and daily voting rosters; no results file and no SOS-only statement.

2026_runoff.fact: Elections page, '2026 May 26th Primary Run-Off' tab: 'Unofficial Results (PDF)' (View/710) is a Cumulative Results Report, county totals, 'Run Time 9:02 PM ... Run Date 05/26/2026', CreationDate May 27 2026 02:03 UTC (9:03 PM CDT). 'Republican-Precinct by Precinct Report' (View/708): Precinct Results Report Unofficial, 'Run Time 12:56 PM ... Run Date 05/27/2026', CreationDate May 27 17:57 UTC, e.g. 'PCT 1 ... Ken Paxton ... 116' election day. County totals on the night (printed run time), precinct numbers next afternoon. Last-Modified headers are request time (no upload evidence).

rationale: Only the runoff is determined (LATER from printed run times: county totals 9:02 PM on the night, precinct report run 05/27 12:56 PM). One determined election gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, confidence low.
